test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.

Dinisha visits her mother __once in a blue moon__.
solution:
The correct answer is: Very rarely.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"once in a blue moon"** means something that happens very rarely. (बहुत ही कम)

 
 
• **Example: **She visits her grandparents **once in a blue moon**.
 
 
 
• **"Very rarely"** refers to something that doesn't happen often. (बहुत कम)
 
 
• **Example: **He **very rarely** goes out for a walk.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Very frequently **(बहुत बार): Something that happens many times over a short period.

 
 
• **Example:** She visits the library **very frequently**.
 
 
 
• **Every week **(हर सप्ताह): Something that happens once every week.
 
 
• **Example: **They meet **every week** for a study session.
 
 
 
• **Every month** (हर महीने): Something that happens once every month.
 
 
• **Example:** The committee meets **every month** to discuss progress.
 
 

1ab:T635,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
